Could not see outer box/wrapper text saying 'BLASTER' or 'MEGA', so the blaster classification of the pack open is inferred (single 8-card pack) at med confidence. Confirmed inserts: Kyren Williams After Image AI-17 (compId 36, card BACK readable at f_0313), Bryce Young Sunday Showcase (compId 26, f_0312), Trey Amos Yellow & Blue Commanders (compId 38, f_0316). Most other cards are BASE veteran/rookie cards whose targets (Quentin Johnston, Drake London, Caleb Williams) only exist as inserts/parallels in the list, so they are reported as null. Several base players' names were not legible at frame resolution.
